items.headline: RBI MPC meeting begins, 'hawkish pause' on repo rate expected amidst inflation concerns
items.summary: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee began its three-day meeting on August 3, 2026, and is widely anticipated to keep the benchmark repo rate unchanged at 5.25%. This expected 'hawkish pause' is attributed to persistent inflation risks from geopolitical tensions, elevated crude oil prices, and an uneven monsoon. June retail inflation accelerated to 4.38%, and wholesale inflation climbed to 9.87%.

items.headline: Crude oil prices fall sharply, FIIs continue buying, boosting Indian market amidst mixed global cues
items.summary: Brent crude futures fell more than 5% to approximately $84 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude slipped below $81 a barrel, spurred by hopes of a diplomatic breakthrough between the US and Iran. This reduction in oil prices is particularly beneficial for India. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) have also shown renewed buying interest, infusing Rs 20,200 crore into Indian equities in July. Global markets presented a mixed picture, with Asian markets generally lower, while US stock futures indicated a positive opening.

items.headline: DLF, Bharti Airtel, ONGC, LIC, SBI, Mankind Pharma among key companies in focus for Q1 FY27 earnings
items.summary: Several prominent companies including DLF, Bharti Airtel, ONGC, LIC, and State Bank of India are scheduled to announce their Q1 FY27 financial results today, August 3, 2026. Mankind Pharma reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 5.68 billion, a 29.6% year-on-year increase. Thermax, however, reported an 85% year-on-year decline in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 220 million.

items.headline: Indian benchmark indices recover; Auto, Financial Services, and Media sectors lead gains
items.summary: Last week, benchmark indices staged a strong recovery, with the BSE Sensex advancing 2.67% and the NSE Nifty climbing 2.59%. On Friday, August 2, the Auto and Financial Services sectors witnessed buying, while the IT and private bank sectors experienced selling pressure. Media, Auto, and Financial Services led the gains, while IT, FMCG, and Consumer Durables were among the major laggards.

items.headline: Britannia appoints new strategy head; several companies announce dividends; new F&O Closing Auction Session introduced
items.summary: Britannia Industries Limited announced the appointment of Siddharth Parakh as Head - Strategy & Business Development, effective August 3, 2026. Several companies, including Bannari Amman Spinning Mills, Coforge, Emkay Global Financial Services, and ICICI Bank, announced dividends with August 3, 2026, as the record date. A new Closing Auction Session (CAS) for eligible Futures & Options (F&O) stocks came into effect, extending derivatives trading by 10 minutes.
